The '''Wayfar Cloning Facility''' could be found in the small [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

It was situated in a small, sand-[[Color/Legends|colored]] building with an unknown number of floors below ground. It contained the technology necessary to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] beings, as well as a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
The cloning facility is a place in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It provides players with a place to [[Wikipedia:Spawning (video gaming)|respawn]] ("clone") on Tatooine after they have been killed. The canonical status of such cloning facilities in ''Star Wars Galaxies'' is unknown.

The type of building used for this cloning facility is also used in many other places on Tatooine in the game. It usually features a turbolift to access two lower levels, but the buttons to operate the elevator were removed in this building.
